activity.notes: Bartlett served as the elected congressional Delegate from the Territory of Alaska from 3 January 1945 to Alaska statehood on 3 January 1959. This is a representative office, so ATLAS uses serves rather than a ruler relation.

sources.title: BARTLETT, Edward Lewis (Bob) — U.S. House of Representatives: History, Art & Archives
sources.citation_text: The official congressional biography records Bartlett as Delegate from the Territory of Alaska from 3 January 1945 through 3 January 1959.
